name: Seal Row
cues: Raise a flat bench on blocks so the bar hangs clear of the floor
Lie face down with your chin just past the end of the bench
Row the bar up until it touches the underside of the bench
Keep your chest on the pad the whole set

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Rows to the bench underside with the chest held on the pad (-10 mm vs 15 tol). Top elbow 133, humerus lateral 0.84, z -0.07. The legs stick out rigid and level ~0.45 m past the 1.3 m bench, which reads as a 'superman' hover in the hero. Owner call: a longer bench (~1.6 m) or legs dropping slightly at the hip/knee.
